'''Sujimis sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Sujimis include [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]], [[Karazak/Legends|Karazak]], [[Maryx Minor/Legends|Maryx Minor]], [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]], and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]].
